title: Vector store connection timeout after deploy
description: After the 2.3.0 release, the API pods intermittently returned 503 from /health. Root cause was the Chroma persistent volume claim not being ready before the pod started serving traffic.
resolution: Added a readiness probe delay and an init container that waits for the volume mount before the main container starts. Retrieval_hit_rate metric returned to baseline within ten minutes of the fix.

title: Hybrid retrieval alpha tuning request
description: Sales engineering reported that questions containing exact product SKUs were returning irrelevant answers under the default hybrid alpha of 0.6.
resolution: Ran the evaluation harness with alpha swept from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1 on a labeled query set containing SKU-heavy questions. Confirmed alpha=0.4 improved hit-rate at k=5 for that query subset without regressing the general query set, and exposed alpha as a per-request override in the /query API so callers can tune it per use case.

title: Agent loop exceeded max_steps on a comparison question
description: A user asked the agent to compare two configuration options and it hit the six-step cap without producing a final answer.
resolution: Traced the issue to the planner splitting the goal into four sub-queries plus a calculation step, leaving no budget for the finish step. Increased default max_steps to eight for agent runs and added a check that always reserves the final step for synthesis.

title: PII redaction missed a phone number format
description: During a QA review, a phone number written as 416.555.0182 with periods instead of dashes was not redacted by the transform stage's PII scrub hook.
resolution: Updated the phone number regex in transform.py to also match period-separated formats and added a regression unit test covering dash, period, and parenthesis phone formats.
